<!--
Straight answer first, because it saves you waiting: nobody can add a
wig for a device whose remote they do not physically have, so a request
is not a work item for a maintainer.

Worth knowing: a wig does not have to be proven to be posted. If
somebody has the remote, the wig is welcome even if nobody has been able
to test it against the device yet.

What it IS good for is finding the other person who owns one. That
happens, and this is where it happens.

If you own the device and a blaster, you are already most of the way to
contributing it yourself: CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

**Device:**
<!-- Brand, kind and model as best you know them. -->

**Product identifiers, if you have them:**
<!-- FCC ID (often on a sticker under the battery cover), UPC off the
box, or the Amazon ASIN. For off-brand hardware these matter more than
the brand does, because they are what somebody else's identical unit
would match on. -->

**Anything that would help somebody recognise it:**
<!-- A link to the listing, a photo of the remote, the number of buttons
and what they do. -->

**Do you own the device?**

- [ ] Yes, and I have a blaster, so I could fit it myself with a nudge
- [ ] Yes, but no blaster or no idea where to start
- [ ] No, I am hoping somebody else has one
